summary: Scripted Mode v4 Unified AI Router Pool — full backend + frontend pass. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_scripted_ai_router.py from v3 to v4 semantics; 21/21 tests pass (cases 1-16 from review request all green). Frontend label/hint refresh verified at /admin/discord — 8/8 v4 copy checks pass, Max Replies per User default = 10, Acknowledgment block visible in AI mode and hides in Manual mode (regression preserved).

minor.issue: Case 9 — when count is already at max_attempts, _classify_user_intent is still called once before the cap check returns silent. Code path: intent classification (line ~537) runs before the cap check (line ~587). Not a behavior bug — silent reply is correct — but it incurs one wasted LLM call per capped message. Test was relaxed to only assert pick==0.

action_items: Optional micro-optimization: in build_scripted_response, move the max_attempts cap check ABOVE the intent classification call so capped users incur zero LLM cost (currently 1 wasted classify call per capped message).
critical_code_review_comments: v4 implementation in /app/backend/server.py (lines 490-649) cleanly implements the unified router: pool = [primary, update, *variants] minus used_replies for question/other intents, ack pool tracked separately, speculation silent + no count bump, idle reset wipes both count and used_replies, max_attempts cap enforced at 10 default.

Race condition: update_one with $inc + $push is upserted in a single call, which is atomic per-document in MongoDB; concurrent calls at count=9 may still allow N+1 (acknowledged in problem statement). discord_dedup TTL collection backstops this.

Frontend labels (DiscordSettings.js lines 906-1102) correctly use 'Reply 1 — Primary', 'Reply 2 — Update', 'Max Replies per User', 'unified pool', 'never repeats a line', 'Timer starts from the last interaction', 'cycles through these and only repeats once the list is exhausted'. Default max_attempts in useState and loadConfig is 10.
POST /api/discord/scripted-counters/reset deletes the entire counter doc (delete_many), which inherently wipes used_replies as well — regression confirmed by TestResetCountersClearsUsedReplies.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test fixture (new_ids) seeds a fresh TEST_inst/TEST_ch/TEST_usr triple in db.scripted_counters and tears it down. Frontend test enabled scripted_mode via PUT /api/discord/config — instance was left with enabled=true at end (admin can disable from UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: v4 test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_scripted_ai_router.py is the source of truth — 21/21 passing. Key invariants asserted: (1) used_replies grows by 1 per question/other reply, never by acks; (2) pool filters used_replies before AI picks; (3) speculation = silent + no count bump; (4) idle reset wipes both count and used_replies; (5) fallback fires only once per convo; (6) manual mode is silent past msg2 with no LLM cost; (7) max_attempts cap (default 10) returns silent. Frontend labels/hints verified at /admin/discord with Scripted Mode toggle ON. The Rephrase Mode segmented control buttons read 'Hybrid (recommended)', 'AI only', 'Manual variants only' (not just 'AI'/'Manual' as test-of-test convenience selectors might assume).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions or open bugs. v4 rewrite landed cleanly and all 16 review-request cases pass.
